fields.summary_ko.0: Lucid Group (NASDAQ:LCID) received an additional $1.75B credit facility from Saudi Arabia's PIF, increasing liquidity to $3.75B and covering operations through Q4 2027
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 GAAP net loss of $830.9M significantly exceeded revenue of $350.3M; however, cash burn decreased 30% and gross margin improved to approximately -74%, with PIF-related debt increasing from zero at year-start to approximately $1.69B
